references.text: Joshua gives orders to divide the plunder between those who went out to war and the rest of the tribes, following the same principle as in Numbers 31:27.
David establishes a law that the plunder should be divided equally between those who fought and those who stayed with the equipment, a similar distribution principle.
Describes the half portion given to the Israelites that Moses set apart from the share of the men who had gone to war, a direct application of the distribution principle.
Eleazar the priest gives instructions regarding the plunder for the fighting men, providing the context for the division of war spoils.
Refers to those who go out in the army; the same expression 'הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא' is used for able-bodied warriors.
